==================
inline C at top level starting with a preprocessor line
==================

C{ #include <stdio.h> }C

sub vcl_recv {
    C{
        #include <stdlib.h>
    }C
}

---

(source_file
  (inline_c)
  (toplev_declaration
    (sub_declaration
      (ident)
      (block
        (inline_c)))))

==================
inline C with nested braces and brace runs
==================

sub vcl_recv {
    C{
        if (a) { if (b) { c("}}"); } }
    }C
}

---

(source_file
  (toplev_declaration
    (sub_declaration
      (ident)
      (block
        (inline_c)))))
